source_title: Cabinet secretary lists 12 types of secretaries: File throwers, file sitters, latecomers... - The Times of India
source_excerpt: NEW DELHI: It began as a regular meeting. But the senior bureaucrats who had gathered at a performance review meeting on Tuesday were in for a surprise â and not a particularly pleasant one, even though the point was made with a generous dose of humour.Cabinet secretary T V Somanathan unveiled a presentation on 12 types of bureaucrats, which is believed to have left many present at the meeting squirming. Among the types listed by Somanathan were officers who ask women colleagues to come a bit too close for comfort to show them a document; those who throw files and speak rudely; and those who call in staff on Saturdays, then arrive late themselves.Other entries included officers who call meetings after 7pm, sit on files, or send ministers decisions they could take themselves.
